 1 | # Fluid.Glass Aesthetic Alignment & Motion Plan
 2 | 
 3 | ## 1. Analysis of Fluid.Glass Inspiration
 4 | `fluid.glass` represents a high-end, brutalist-minimalist approach to digital product design. It relies heavily on stark contrasts, precise geometry, and extreme typographic hierarchy. 
 5 | 
 6 | **Core Paradigms to Adopt:**
 7 | - **Strict Geometry:** Zero border radius (`rounded-none`). All containers, buttons, and UI elements must have sharp, 90-degree corners.
 8 | - **Hairline Borders:** Borders should be exclusively 1px (`border`, `border-ink/10`) to establish a technical, blueprint-like grid aesthetic.
 9 | - **Massive Typography:** Hero sections should use oversized, tightly kerned typography (e.g., `text-7xl` or `text-8xl`, `tracking-tighter`, `leading-none`).
10 | - **High-Contrast Monospace Details:** Secondary metadata, system statuses, and sub-labels must use monospaced fonts (`font-mono`) with uppercase styling and wide tracking (`uppercase tracking-[0.2em]`).
11 | - **Pervasive Grid Alignment:** Layouts should feel like a rigid structural grid.
12 | 
13 | ## 2. Advanced Motion & Transitions Strategy
14 | Beyond static visuals, the aesthetic relies on high-end, cinematic physics.
15 | 
16 | **Core Motion Pillars:**
17 | - **Momentum Scrolling:** Utilizing Lenis to create weight and inertia on page scroll.
18 | - **Staggered Reveals:** Utilizing GSAP to reveal typography line-by-line using `overflow-hidden` wrappers, preventing layout shift while adding technical precision to content entry.
19 | - **SVG Mask Transitions (Codrops Inspired):** Implementing advanced SVG clip-path/mask transitions triggered by GSAP `ScrollTrigger` between major block sections. This will create dynamic, non-linear section wipes that break the rigid grid momentarily during scroll, enhancing the high-tech feel.
20 | - **Pixel Image Reveal Effect (On Hold):** A canvas/WebGL-based pixelation dissolve effect for media elements. *(Currently documented but paused to prioritize layout and SVG masks).*
21 | 
22 | ## 3. Gaps in the Current Sandbox & UI Blocks
23 | The current state of our UI blocks (e.g., `sandbox.php`, `cta-banner`, `accordion-group`) relies heavily on default Tailwind aesthetics, creating a disjointed experience compared to our strict `design-system.php` tokens.
24 | 
25 | **Specific Gaps:**
26 | - **Rounded Corners:** Blocks currently use `rounded-xl` or `rounded-3xl`.
27 | - **Soft Shadows:** Blocks use `shadow-md` or `shadow-xl`, which feel too soft and "floaty".
28 | - **Color Inconsistency:** Blocks fallback to `bg-slate-50` or `text-slate-900` instead of our strict `bg-canvas`, `bg-ink`, `text-ink`, and `bg-oceanic-dark` tokens.
29 | - **Typography:** Standard prose lacks the extreme scale and technical monospaced contrasts.
30 | - **DOM Structure:** Missing wrapper `div`s required for GSAP to animate elements cleanly.
31 | 
32 | ## 4. Phased Execution Plan
33 | 
34 | ### Phase 1: Global Setup & Typography
35 | - Overhaul `src/index.css` to enforce global `bg-canvas` and `text-ink`.
36 | - Enforce the massive header / tight kerning / monospace metadata typography scale across the base layer.
37 | 
38 | ### Phase 2: Block Snippet Overhaul (Geometry & Tokens)
39 | - Iterate through every block in `site/snippets/blocks/*.php`.
40 | - Strip all instances of `rounded-*` and soft `shadow-*`.
41 | - Replace default Tailwind gray colors with exact Design System tokens.
42 | - Apply `tech-border` (1px solid borders) to structural elements.
43 | 
44 | ### Phase 3: Page Template Alignment
45 | - Audit outer wrappers in `site/templates/default.php` and `sandbox.php` to ensure the core page grid strictly adheres to the geometry rules.
46 |

48 | - **DOM Restructuring:** Wrap necessary text nodes and media elements in `overflow-hidden` containers to prepare for GSAP reveals.
